EmailTemplate.subject: Admission Information for Master of Arts in Communication Studies
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Greetings. It is my pleasure to inform you that after careful evaluation of our applicants, we are pleased to recommend your admission to the Master of Arts in Communication Studies (MACS), at Arizona State University. Although you should consider this notice an unofficial acceptance (your official acceptance will come via email from the ASU Graduate College), please accept my sincere congratulations on behalf of the MACS program Graduate Admissions Committee.
As Director of MACS, I welcome you to our program and invite you to contact me with any questions you may have concerning your admission. Prior to the start of the semester we have scheduled a mandatory orientation meeting and I will provide information to help you as you being the process of earning you M.A. In addition, you will be able to meet your fellow entering students and ask questions about the program.
You will find answers to many questions in the program handbook found here https://newcollege.asu.edu/advising/graduate/communication-studies-ma. It contains a great deal of information. If you have questions related to tuition, financial aid or housing, please view the next steps section found here: https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/admission-next-steps for a number of University Offices available to assist you. If you have questions related to the program or registration, please contact the Academic Success Coordinator, Jan Lacey at ncgradadvising@asu.edu.
In the meantime, congratulations! I look forward to meeting you at our orientation and please click the following link for next steps: https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/admission-next-steps
Please follow this link to complete a form to either accept or decline our offer of admission. https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/acceptance-form
Lindsey Mean, PhD Associate Professor & Director of MA Communication Studies Program School of Social and Behavioral Sciences Phone: 602-543-6682 Lindsey.Mean@asu.edu
